{{Top|leg}}
A '''floating droid''' was a round hovering [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used as a moving target in the game of [[Backstop]]. About the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] head, it glowed while active and was remotely controlled by a player using a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. The droid recorded successful hits and friendly-fire incidents during each round, producing a musical "thunk" when struck and a different tone when players accidentally hit one another. At the end of a timed round, the droid stopped glowing and came to a complete halt.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
